# Image Source

The `.src` property represents the source file for an image element. Use it to change which image is displayed, such as showing a different step, screen, character, or result.
name: Image Source
tips:
- Use `.src` on an image element that has already been selected.
- Put the image filename or URL in quotation marks.
- Make sure the filename matches the image file in your project.
- Common image file types include `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, and `.gif`.
- In Web Lab, `.src` often appears inside event handlers that change an image after a button click or user choice.
